sourceObservations: items.c lines 608-686 loads an item's sp2 spell, fixes power from abs(item.sp1), and enters combat spell targeting while retaining the loaded item.
combatinfo-combatchoice.c lines 645-664 treats target types below one as power-count targets and uses the ordinary coordinate picker when range is nonzero.
combatinfo-combatchoice.c lines 1273-1304 accepts a nonactor battlefield cell when size is nonzero and stores its exact field coordinate.
cast.c lines 85-88 treats nonzero-size target types below two as coordinate destinations rather than actor selectors.
resolvespell.c lines 192-231 applies special 56 to the caster at target[0], retains attacks when size is nonzero, and kills the caster on an occupied or solid destination.
runtimeContract: Arrow of Transportation is an application-owned item projectile. Its first selected open coordinate uses the existing Phase transaction; learned, scroll, and monster spell-list contexts are not applicable because they do not own the source item launch and Castle's monster negative-target path produces incompatible selector data.
